title: Add a Locale('he') RTL variant and a shared pump helper for curriculum_picker_step_test.dart and track_label_step_test.dart
why: This app is Hebrew-primary/RTL (AX-1); 102 other test files in the suite already pump a Locale('he') variant for key screens (many under an _l1_test.dart convention), but these two onboarding/track-setup wizard steps — which render Hebrew curriculum and track-name text on a first-run, high-visibility flow — only ever run under the implicit default (English/LTR) locale. Neither uses a shared pump helper either; both hand-roll their own MaterialApp + delegate list (one of 165 files repo-wide doing this), so an RTL layout regression in the Add-Track wizard has no test to catch it, and localization-delegate drift has to be fixed file-by-file.
recommendation: Add a Locale('he') pumpWidget variant for both steps asserting no overflow/errors under RTL, and adopt (or create, if genuinely absent) a shared pumpApp-style helper instead of the locally-defined wrapWithL10n/buildWidget.
acceptance_criteria: Each file has at least one testWidgets case that sets locale: Locale('he') and asserts the widget renders without overflow/errors.
